title: ON PLANE
scriptLine: Slow: pushing water. Fast: riding on it.

hero.text: There's a speed where your boat stops pushing water and starts riding on it.
hero.prompt: A white runabout up on plane, bow lifted, white spray behind, calm lake and desert mountains.

meaning.label: WHAT IT MEANS
meaning.text: At slow speed the hull sits deep and pushes water. With enough speed it lifts and skims on top. That's on plane.

items.label: Trim all the way down first
Throttle up: the bow rises, the stern digs in
Then the bow drops and the boat levels out
Ease the throttle, bump the trim up a touch

tip.label: QUICK TIP
tip.text: Bow up, then level = on plane

cta: Get on the list. Link in bio.
